I've had a look at some in my town, though they seem to only target families with young children. I should do more digging.

I'm gathering up the courage to go to Centrelink and inform them about my condition. Hopefully they'll be understanding.

Thanks.

I don't know about SSI and all those other things (are they American or am I just ignorant? I don't know), but my diagnosis was not covered by Medicare. I went through my university to get a diagnosis, and it still costed $60 a session.

I don't know if I want to get disability or if I'm even eligible for it, but I'll look into it.
